purpose: Teach: 伊勢/明日香/日テレ/タール/プラハ/瀬戸/譚/挿絵

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、伊勢、絶対、お出張、絶対、行ったの?本気で
lines.en: Mom — did Dad really go on that business trip to Ise?
lines.style: Rapid-fire questions, urgent and genuine. Breathless excitement barely contained. Sharp attack on each interrogative. Leaning in, eyes wide.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達の、本気で、絶対、明日香、絶対、ちゃん、絶対、お家、絶対、来てくれたわ
lines.en: Sho — your friend Asuka actually came over to the house yesterday.
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, gently patient. Slightly slower pace, as if sharing something Sho will find meaningful. Soft landing on the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、日テレ、絶対、の、絶対、ニュース、絶対、見たよ
lines.en: Mom — I saw it on the NTV news.
lines.style: Thoughtful, connecting dots aloud. Quiet conviction beneath the words. Matter-of-fact but tender—he's proud of noticing something real.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの仕事、本気で、絶対、タール、絶対、扱う、絶対、現場、絶対、ある、絶対、らしいわよ
lines.en: Sho — your father's work involves handling tar at the site, apparently.
lines.style: Sharing something learned carefully. Measured tone, neither alarmed nor dismissive. The way you tell a child something real without making it frightening.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、プラハ、絶対、絵本、絶対、読んだよ
lines.en: Mom — I read a picture book about Prague.
lines.style: Bright with his own discovery. Quick, almost eager to share. Small excitement blooming—he found something and wants her to know he found it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、瀬戸、絶対、焼きの、絶対、お皿、絶対、大切なのよ
lines.en: Sho — your grandmother's Seto ware plate is very precious.
lines.style: Respectful, learning the weight of things. Slower, more formal register—he's speaking about something that matters. Careful articulation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、本気で、絶対、譚、絶対、っていう漢字、絶対、初めて見たよ
lines.en: Mom — I saw that kanji—'tan'—for the very first time.
lines.style: Wonder at the newness of a word. Slight pause before it, like holding the strange character up to the light. Genuine delight in learning.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、絵本の、絶対、挿絵、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、描いた、絶対、らしいわよ
lines.en: Sho — your father apparently drew the illustrations in that picture book.
lines.style: Settling into something important and surprising. Slower cadence, letting it land. Quiet amazement that a parent can make something beautiful.
